builds.hypothesis:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals [25 / 37.5 / 50 + (0.19) × AP] magic damage and [(((0.16) × ((1 + (3.125) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2])))) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, and applies [40]% Grievous Wounds for [3] seconds.

Total over [2.5] seconds to each enemy: [(25 / 37.5 / 50 + (0.19) × AP) × ((6) × (2.5))] magic damage and [((((0.16) × ((1 + (3.125) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2])))) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((6) × (2.5))] physical damage.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers. Nashors Tooth replaces Banshee for attack speed/cadence (Azir) or reduced R on-hit delivery (Katarina), with on-hit eligibility measured.

Rune reasoning: Katarina — Death Lotus: This AP-only inventory gives no item bonus AD. The native physical term is proportional to bonus AD times bonus attack speed, so Alacrity and an AS shard cannot raise that zero term or create extra magic daggers. Adaptive stats and earned Bloodline HP through Riftmaker support the fixed magic channel instead. Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while the owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: This AP-only inventory has no bonus AD for the native AS-times-bonus-AD physical term. Fifteen earned stacks give85HP feeding actual Riftmaker AP; lifesteal stays separate. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Exactly fifteen earned Bloodline stacks provide85HP; observe its actual Riftmaker AP conversion and keep any healing separate. Use the authored complete2.5-second channel and real fixed dagger count, with Gathering Storm at minute30. No prior attack, HoB trigger or free bonusAD is added.

Rune comparison: Compare a hybrid inventory with real bonus AD before testing Alacrity or a legally pre-triggered HoB variant. Record the physical coefficient and AS snapshot; this is a different build/setup. Compare the AP native channel with one adaptive-versus-AS shard swap while logging actual AP, bonus AD and dagger count. Item on-hits and Deathfire burn remain separate.

Stat shards: Adaptive offense and flex feed the .19-AP native magic dagger term; scaling HP feeds equipped Riftmaker AP. Attack speed is not extra magic strikes, and multiplying a zero bonus-AD physical term gives no gain.
